purpose: Define assurance level transitions (`none`, `light`, `medium`, `strong`) as explicit authentication state changes governed by allowed methods and expiry/revalidation rules.

topics.name: IAM Assurance Lifecycle
topics.purpose: Define assurance level transitions (`none`, `light`, `medium`, `strong`) as explicit authentication state changes governed by allowed methods and expiry/revalidation rules.

semantics.strong_example: shell-only or otherwise explicitly stronger authenticated context
semantics.transition_rule: Assurance level changes only after an explicit successful authentication/reauthentication event.
semantics.downgrade_rule: Assurance may expire/downgrade according to explicit session/resource policy.
semantics.authorization_rule: Higher assurance does not itself grant additional AccessCore rights.
semantics.resource_rule: A resource/operation may require a minimum assurance level independently from authorization.

invariants.rule: Identity lifecycle, authentication assurance, credential state and session state remain explicit and cannot be inferred from authorization, transport or profile data.

hard_gates.condition: resource minimum assurance omitted where required

references.purpose: Lifecycle applies to IAM assurance semantics.
